metadata.question: Was the aerosol optical depth higher over the Takalaman Desert in February 2020 than in February 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS aerosol products (MCD19A2 or MOD08_M3 for monthly AOD) - Date: February 2019 vs February 2020 - Location: Taklamakan Desert (approximately 38-40°N, 81-87°E in Xinjiang, China) 2. Masking strategy: - Use QA bands to filter out low-quality AOD retrievals - No cloud masking needed (AOD is specifically measuring aerosols) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid AOD range is typically 0-5 (could be slightly negative due to calibration, but typically 0-3) - Check if collections have data for both years - Check if valid pixels exist after QA filtering - Compare mean AOD values: if 2020 > 2019, answer A; otherwise B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Taklamakan Desert region const taklamakan = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[81.0, 37.5], [87.0, 37.5], [87.0, 41.0], [81.0, 41.0], [81.0, 37.5]] ]); // 2. Load MODIS Aerosol Optical Depth data const aod2019 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD19A2_GRANULES') .filterDate('2019-02-01', '2019-03-01') .filterBounds(taklamakan) .select('Optical_Depth_047'); const aod2020 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD19A2_GRANULES') .filterDate('2020-02-01', '2020-03-01') .filterBounds(taklamakan) .select('Optical_Depth_047'); const size2019 = aod2019.size().getInfo(); const size2020 = aod2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Images: ${size2019}`); console.log(`2020 Images: ${size2020}`); if (size2019 === 0 || size2020 === 0) { console.log('Empty collection for one or both periods'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Calculate mean AOD for each period (scale factor 0.001) const mean2019_img = aod2019.mean().multiply(0.001); const mean2020_img = aod2020.mean().multiply(0.001); // 4. Check pixel counts const count2019 = mean2019_img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: taklamakan, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Optical_Depth_047').getInfo(); const count2020 = mean2020_img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: taklamakan, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Optical_Depth_047').getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Valid Pixels: ${count2019}`); console.log(`2020 Valid Pixels: ${count2020}`); if (count2019 === 0 || count2020 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 5. Calculate mean AOD values const aod2019_val = mean2019_img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: taklamakan, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Optical_Depth_047').getInfo(); const aod2020_val = mean2020_img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: taklamakan, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('Optical_Depth_047').getInfo(); console.log(`2019 Mean AOD: ${aod2019_val}`); console.log(`2020 Mean AOD: ${aod2020_val}`); // 6. Validation and final answer if (aod2019_val === null || aod2020_val === null || isNaN(aod2019_val) || isNaN(aod2020_val) || aod2019_val < -1 || aod2019_val > 5 || aod2020_val < -1 || aod2020_val > 5) { console.log('Invalid AOD values detected'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (aod2020_val > aod2019_val) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
